_comment: One entry per employer. 'engine' is optional — omit it and run `python -m jobcollator.detect <url>` to find out, or just leave it out and collect.py will try to auto-detect on first run and remember the result here. 'location_filter' is applied server-side by the engine (a search param or facet lookup) to cut down request volume, not just the result set — set to null/omit to track every location.

companies.name: Radiometer (Danaher)
companies._note: jobs.danaher.com is a shared career site across Danaher's operating companies, not Radiometer-specific — no server-side filter for that was found, so a handful of postings here may be other Danaher brands (Cytiva, Danaher Corp itself) with a Danish presence rather than Radiometer. The Category column shows each posting's actual operating company (phenom.py's 'opco' field) so these are easy to tell apart on the dashboard.

companies.name: Black Swans Exist
companies._note: A life-science recruitment agency (Denmark & Germany mandates), not an employer's own site — postings are for their clients, often anonymised. The real client/employer, when named, shows up in the Category column instead of here (see black_swan.py).

_unsupported.name: ALK-Abelló
_unsupported.reason: EasyCruit career site sits behind an AWS WAF JS challenge (x-amzn-waf-action: challenge on every plain request) — not scrapable without a real browser, which this tool intentionally doesn't do. Revisit if ALK moves ATS platforms.

_unsupported.name: Syneos Health
_unsupported.reason: Cloudflare 'Attention Required' bot-challenge on every plain request — same category of block as ALK's, not scrapable without a real browser.

_unsupported.name: Demant
_unsupported.reason: Runs a third variant of the SAP SuccessFactors Jobs2Web platform — a tile/AJAX-paginated layout (apiEndpoint 'tile-search-results'), not the server-rendered <table id="searchresults"> layout sf_j2w.py parses (confirmed used by Novo Nordisk, Lundbeck, LEO Pharma, Coloplast). Not bot-blocked, just needs a new engine variant — nobody's built it yet.

_unsupported.name: Xellia Pharmaceuticals
_unsupported.reason: No recognized ATS platform found (not Workday/SF/Phenom/Attrax/Jibe/Workable) and only ~4-10 open roles globally at any time — low value for the engineering effort of a bespoke scraper. Revisit if that changes.

_unsupported.name: Evaxion Biotech
_unsupported.reason: No recognized ATS platform found; ~50 employees total, very few open roles at any time. Low value for a bespoke scraper.

_unsupported.name: Saniona
_unsupported.reason: No recognized ATS platform found; had 0 open positions when checked. Low value for a bespoke scraper.

_unsupported.name: SNIPR Biome
_unsupported.reason: No recognized ATS platform found; ~42 employees total, had 0 open positions when checked. Low value for a bespoke scraper.

_unsupported.name: MedWatch.dk
_unsupported.reason: This is a Danish pharma/life-science trade publication's sponsored job board (would have been an aggregator source, not an employer's own site) — but its robots.txt explicitly disallows the 'Claude-User' agent ('Anthropic - user-initiated fetches in Claude') site-wide. That's exactly what this tool acting on the user's behalf is, so it's not fetched regardless of what literal User-Agent header this tool sends — spoofing a different one to route around a rule that targets Claude by identity would be exactly the kind of evasion this tool's own README commits it not to do. Revisit only if MedWatch changes that policy.

_unsupported.name: Jobindex.dk
_unsupported.reason: Denmark's largest general job board (would have been an aggregator source, not an employer's own site). Its robots.txt explicitly disallows '/jobsoegning*subid=', which rules out the only precise way to scope results to a pharma/biotech-relevant category (its RSS feed's `subid` param). The allowed alternative — free-text `q=<keyword>` search — was tested with several pharma/biotech terms and returned too much off-topic noise to be usable (e.g. "pharma" matched a district-heating company's facility job, "life science" matched kindergarten pedagogue postings), apparently due to fuzzy/stemmed full-text matching rather than a title/category match. Revisit if Jobindex exposes a more precise, robots.txt-allowed way to filter by industry.

_unsupported.name: Danish Medicines Agency (Lægemiddelstyrelsen)
_unsupported.reason: All vacancies run through HR-Manager, the shared Danish state recruitment platform (candidate.hr-manager.net), whose robots.txt disallows crawling almost everything ('Disallow: /' with one narrow exception unrelated to listings) — same category of block as ALK-Abelló/Syneos, not scrapable without a real browser.

_unsupported.name: Nordic Bioscience
_unsupported.reason: Embeds an iframe from candidate.hr-manager.net (customer=nordicbioscience_tr) — the same HR-Manager platform as the Danish Medicines Agency, blocked by the same broad robots.txt disallow.

_unsupported.name: Ambu
_unsupported.reason: Runs the newer React-based 'Unify' variant of SAP SuccessFactors Jobs2Web (same underlying platform family as Novo Nordisk/Coloplast, but not the server-rendered <table id="searchresults"> layout sf_j2w.py parses) — same unsupported variant as Demant. Its data comes from a clean JSON API (POST /services/recruiting/v1/jobs, body {"locale":"en_GB"}), confirmed working and not robots.txt-blocked, but its pagination parameters weren't pinned down (totalJobs is 101; the default page returns ~10 non-deterministically-ordered results with no confirmed offset param) — needs more work to enumerate the full listing reliably before it's worth wiring up a 'j2w_unify' engine. Fixing this would likely also unblock Demant.
_unsupported._engine_notes: Confirmed working: POST https://jobs.ambu.com/services/recruiting/v1/jobs with JSON body {"locale":"en_GB"} returns {jobSearchResult: [...], totalJobs: N}. Each item's `response` has jobLocationCountry, unifiedStandardTitle, unifiedUrlTitle, id, city, unifiedStandardStart. Job detail URL pattern not yet confirmed. Next step: find the real pagination param (tried pageNum/pageSize, start/num — neither changed the page deterministically) by reading the minified j2w.searchResultsUnify.min.js / reactWidgetLoader.js bundles rather than guessing.

_unsupported.name: Fertin Pharma
_unsupported.reason: Uses two different systems for different job categories: Salesforce Sites (aspeya.my.salesforce-sites.com/Recruit/fRecruit__ApplyJob) for most roles, and a separate 'Job Match Profile' portal (app.jobmatchprofile.com) for production-shift roles specifically. Neither is a platform this tool has an engine for yet, and the Salesforce Sites recruiting app in particular is an obscure enough platform (not seen elsewhere in this list) that it wasn't investigated further given the split-system complexity. Revisit if it turns out to matter enough to justify a bespoke two-source engine.
